title: Ates's Low On Fire!
description: When you get burned, no burning effect appears and your FPS doesn't drop.
body:
🔥 **Ates's Low on Fire – Resource Pack**

Low on Fire is a simple yet powerful Minecraft resource pack that reduces the size of fire effects on your screen. When you're on fire, the default flames can block your vision and make it harder to see what’s happening around you. This pack solves that problem by making the fire smaller and less distracting.

With improved visibility, you can focus better during PvP battles, parkour challenges, or survival gameplay. It gives you a cleaner and more competitive experience without changing the core look of the game too much.

If you want better vision and smoother gameplay while burning, Low on Fire is the perfect choice.
